title.en: Freezing the Prices of Lands in Metropolitan Manila At Current Market Value

text.en:
Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, the prices of lands within Metropolitan
Manila, shall until further orders be frozen at current market value determined in accordance with Presidential
Decree No. 76, as amended, and other pertinent laws, decrees, rules or regulations.

Any person who violates this Decree shall suffer the penalty provided under Section 21 of
Presidential Decree No. 1517.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 21st day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-nine.
